senses.gloss:
वैडाल वैडाल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विडाल), of or
belonging to a cat, peculiar to cats, feline.
—वैडाल-
व्रत, अम्, n. ‘cat-like observance,’ putting on a
show of virtue or piety to conceal malice and evil
designs.
—वैडाल-व्रति, इस्, m. one who leads a
chaste or continent life merely from the absence of
women or temptation.
—वैडालव्रतिक, अस्, ई, अम्,
or वैडालव्रतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, acting like a cat, hypo-
critical; any hypocritical religious impostor or pre-
tended ascetic who, under an appearance of piety
and virtue, conceals covetous or malignant designs
(= भण्ड-तपस्विन्).
